proposed_sites.reason: Module-level attribute assignment for API key configuration is removed in v1; must be replaced with an explicit client object, e.g. client = OpenAI(api_key=...).
Module-level namespaced call pattern openai.ChatCompletion.create(...) is removed in v1; must migrate to client.chat.completions.create(...).
openai.error submodule is removed in v1; RateLimitError now lives at the top level as openai.RateLimitError.
openai.error submodule is removed in v1; ServiceUnavailableError (or its v1 equivalent) now lives at the top level, not under openai.error.
